From my heart

To my everything

HAPPY 5 MONTHS ANNIVERSARY MI CORAZON. I'm so damn happy to have met you. Youve brought nothing but joy into my life. I love you so damn much baby, I can never seem to stop saying it but its true, Im always wanting to be in your presence again, Im just obsessed with you. Im so glad that god sent you to save me, im genuinely so happy to have you, youll all ill ever will need in my life, not money, not big house, or anything at all. I mean this in the most selfish way possible, i want to keep you forever, not letting anyone fall in love with the same eyes, smile, and heart that I did. I would go through all that anguish, torture, and agony I had faced in my life knowing youre going to be there in the end. I want to be able to wake up next to my beautiful wife, coming home to you, cooking with you, or doing literally anything with you. The only thing I want in this world is to be able to die next to you, to be able to wither away from this earth with you, and as our body begins to be swallowed by the dirt and bugs, they would taste and feel the love I carry for you. I love your eyes, your gentle voice, your adorable laugh and the snort you do, the jokes that you make, your style, your intelligence, your hair, just everything about you makes me fall even harder for you and makes me think you’re just a dream, because there’s no way someone like you can be mine. May we spend even more months, years, and even eons together. Happy 5 month my love. I love you so very much, no matter what.
Always, Gerardo
